page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with a contents list at top, a dedication with verse below. No margin notes. Handwriting on the right edge is not printed text.

main_text.l: Hysterologia methodica instar turbati in syllogismo
Crypsis poetica incipere à medio, & ibi comprehendere
Crypsis oratoria firmissima primo summoq; loco po-
Turbida cùm Veneris celebraret Gallia festum
Nuper, & in dapibus dira venena daret:
Aurea utrinq; vocant bipatentibus atria valvis
Convivas: sed Mars sponsus & hospes erat.
Et Bellona ferox immissos crinibus angues
Bellonæ junctus crudeles actus in iras
Mars, manibus versans tela inimica suis.
Manera, nunc animam sponsis pro dote, rependat
Quisq; suam, jam nunc Ægide, dixit, opus.
Non lacrymas precium ve, preces, cum sanguine vitam
Poscimus. hîs dictis, ensis & arma micant.

page.notes: Verse lines are italic in the print; the Greek-free dedication is set in italic. Some letters are worn, e.g. "Manera" and "Ægide" read as printed with doubtful letters. The contents list uses figures as printed.
